sources.excerpt: Published on May 18, 2009 Skreddy Pedals fuzz pedal preview preview Information Skreddy Pedals Smooth, Intense, Sustaining Distortion The most balanced, sweet-sounding 4-transistor fuzz I can make (with parts available to me) today. I think you are going to love it. Not super, over-the-top, crazy-high gain, but walks the fine line between aggressive and laid-back. Lay into the notes for that deep, harmonic saturation and violin-like sustain. All your detail and articulation are preserved throughout the sustain knob's travel. Low noise floor, too!
